body.p: The present application includes pending claims 8-15, 17-30 and 32-37. Claims 8- 15, 17-30 and 32-37 have been rejected. The Office Action of March 4, 2024 ("FOA") has been carefully considered.

Reconsideration in view of the following remarks is respectfully requested. Though the Applicant generally disagrees with such rejections, to expedite allowance of various pending claims, claims 8 and 23 have been amended.

Note that such amendments are in no way to be construed as the Applicant agreeing with any rejections not specifically discussed below. The Applicant respectfully traverses the above rejections at least for the reasons previously set forth during prosecution and at least based on the following remarks. Reconsideration and allowance of the claims in view of the following remarks are respectfully requested.

Claims 8-15, 17-30, and 32-37 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being allegedly anticipated by Alden (U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2004/0198436) further in view of McLoone (U.S. Patent No. 8,064,972) in view of Reiss (U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2011/0130203) in further view of Applicant Admitted Prior Art (AAPA).

The Applicant traverses these rejections, but in order to advance prosecution has amended claims 8 and 23. Claims 8 and 23 as amended render moot and therefore overcome the rejection under 35 U.S.C. 103.
Claims 8-15, 17-30 and 32-37 as amended are allowable.
The Office Action makes various statements, including without limitation statements regarding the claims, 35 U.S.C. § 103, the cited references, one of ordinary skill

in the art, etc., that are now moot in view of the previously presented amendments and/or arguments. Thus, the Applicant will not address all of such statements at the present time. However, the Applicant expressly reserves the right to challenge such statements in the future should the need arise (e.g., if such statements should become relevant by reappearing in a rejection of any current or future claim or be relied upon in any proceeding involving this application or a corresponding patent). The Applicant also respectfully reserves the right to argue additional reasons that support the allowability of all claims, whether or not argued in this Response or previous responses, should that need arise in the future.

The Applicant submits that the pending claims are in condition for allowance and courteously solicits an expeditious Notice of Allowability with respect to all pending claims. If the Examiner has any questions or the Applicant can be of any assistance, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney.
The Commissioner is authorized to charge any necessary fees, or credit any overpayment to the Deposit Account of McAndrews, Held & Malloy, Account No. 13- 0017.
McAndrews, Held & Malloy, Ltd. 500 W. Madison Street
